name: Panza + Havok + Bonus_Bass
description: Psy Frequency presents a trance music night featuring sets by Panza, Havok, and Bonus_Bass at Era uma vez no Porto.
longDescription:
Psy Frequency hosts a trance night at Era uma vez no Porto on 26 November 2026. The musical lineup features Panza, Havok, and Bonus_Bass.

The party takes place at Rua da Madeira, 126, running through the night from 23:59 to 06:00. Admission is restricted to attendees aged 18 and older.
